thread:
jess: Hey infra — requesting a new GCP project + quota bump for a customer pilot (MLEdge). We need H100 x4 and L4 x8 in asia-south1, 10 static external IPs, and an increase to Cloud NAT ephemeral ports to 1000. Project id: redwood-mledge-asia. Billing account: growth-billing-ct-42. Estimated spend ~12k/mo. Need project approval + quota by Tuesday for onboarding tests. TL;DR: H100(4), L4(8), 10 static IPs, NAT ports 1000, VPC peering with customer VPC.

matt: Ack. Can you paste the GCP project creation request link and a short justification I can include in the quota ticket?

jess: Sure — form submitted here: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas/ask?ticket=GCP-7892 (internal link). Justification: customer pilot requires low-latency inference close to APAC users; model parallel tests need H100s for perf parity and L4 for cost-sensitive batch workloads. We'll run CI+perf tests for 2 weeks.

kevin: Quick Q: will these GPUs be preemptible/spot or on-demand? That affects quotas and quota approvals.

jess: On-demand for H100s (stable perf) and spot for L4 where possible. We'll tag workloads and cap preemptible fallback.

olivia: Ping infra-bot to create the quota increase ticket with required SKU numbers. Also need confirmation of service accounts and key rotation plan for the project.

infra-bot: Created ticket GCP-7892 in our tracking system and notified GCP support. Linked docs: https://redwood.internal/infra/gcp-requests/GCP-7892. ETA from GCP: ~48-72h, but asia-south1 H100 availability is limited — may be queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

danielle: FYI asia-south1 has a quota of 0 H100 by default for our org. We'll need org-level approval + quota expansion. Also external IP quota in that region is low; recommend requesting a global addresses raise and reserve the IPs once approved.

matt: Also need to ensure the billing account has free trial credits exhausted? growth-billing-ct-42 is a paid account, good. Can infra verify billing link to project before we request GPUs?

kevin: Note on networking: VPC peering to customer VPC will require custom routes and increased interconnect capacity if they push >5Gbps. Do we have a PoP near their region? Suggest we add a note to the ticket to request interconnect quota if throughput >5Gbps.

jess: Added note to the ticket about expected <2Gbps for now, but we'll monitor. If tests go well, we'll ask for interconnect capacity increase. Thanks.

olivia: I'll provision the project skeleton once quota ticket is in flight. Can someone assign me the service account owners and the SRE oncall to add to the ACL?

jess: Assigned: service account owner = matt, SRE oncall = kevin. Also adding danielle for billing ops.

infra-bot: GCP support replied with initial review: "We've received your request; H100 capacity availability in asia-south1 may be limited. Please provide fallback region(s) or accept delayed provisioning." Case ID: 84321.

matt: Propose fallback to asia-east1 (if H100 available) or use L4 pool + model sharding. Jess, confirm fallback regions.

jess: Confirm fallback to asia-east1, and fallback plan to L4 with model quantization if H100 delayed. We'll update the ticket with both options.

danielle: Cost note: if H100s are allocated on-demand, estimate = $3.2k per H100 GPU/mo (est), so 4x ~12.8k + L4 costs ~1.2k. Aligns with the ~12k/mo estimate but add buffer for networking and IPs. Put a 20% buffer in the cost projection.

olivia: Approved provisional project creation once ticket is acknowledged by GCP (no final GPU allocation yet). I'll create the project and set org policies (no external service account keys, forced KMS for secrets).

matt: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — I'll update the ticket with billing and fallback region. Jess, flag me in thread when you want me to finalize the IAM roles.

jess: Will do. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :raised_hands:
